articles.title: Toronto mayor files urgent motion demanding province 'return our waterfront' after feds reject airport plans
articles.summary: Toronto’s mayor says she filed an urgent motion Monday to demand the province give back waterfront land after the federal government rejected a proposal for a jet expansion at Billy Bishop Airport.

articles.title: Man faces charges after driving through busy playground, splash pad in Ajax: police
articles.summary: An Aurora man is facing two charges after allegedly driving through an Ajax park that was full of pedestrians earlier this month, Durham police say.

articles.title: Durham deputy chief retires after misconduct finding over 'racially inappropriate term'
articles.summary: A deputy chief with the Durham Regional Police Service is retiring after an investigation found he committed misconduct, the police board says.

articles.title: U.S. Consulate fired upon for 2nd time this year, police seek suspect vehicle
articles.summary: Police say the U.S. Consulate in Toronto, which was shot at in March, was again the target of gunfire Monday morning. Investigators say they pursued a suspect vehicle to the Don Valley Parkway immediately after the shooting, but called off the chase when it reached dangerous speeds.

articles.title: Body found near train tracks in Brampton being investigated as suspicious death: police
articles.summary: Peel police say they are investigating a suspicious death after a body was found near train tracks in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: Hundreds of Torontonians celebrate after feds reject Billy Bishop jet expansion
articles.summary: Hundreds of Toronto residents and advocates are celebrating after the federal government rejected support for a proposed expansion to accommodate jets at Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport.

articles.title: Carney calls August byelection for Beaches-East York riding
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has called three byelections in the B.C. riding of North Vancouver–Capilano, the Ontario riding of Beaches-East York and the Quebec riding of Chicoutimi—Le Fjord.
